criteria.requirement: Add DateTimeParser.parse_strict(text, format_or_list, normalize_whitespace=False, *, exact_width=False) and arrow.get(text, format_or_list, strict=True, exact_width=False). Strict matching consumes the whole normalized input with valid calendar values; old parse/get extraction defaults remain unchanged. Optional exact width requires single digit M/D/H/h/m/s, three day-of-year digits and the declared fractional S count; literals are not tokens. Keep token/localization semantics including corrected numeric weekdays, format-list fallback and timezone parsing. Reject nonboolean switches, literal-only formats and exact_width without strict mode; factory strict mode requires explicit formats.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
